name: The Root of Evil
source:
Global Game Jam 2023 prompt: Roots

An homage to webtoons and mangas about villainesses where you play as a plant who is discovered by a villainess. As both of you nourish each other, you slowly become aware of her inevitable downfall. Will you help her bloom? Or will you cause her to wilt away?

[From [url=https://vnnuuuuu.itch.io/the-root-of-evil]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
Global Game Jam 2023提示：根源

向有关反派的网络漫画和漫画致敬，在其中，你扮演一株被反派发现的植物。当你们互相滋养时，你慢慢地意识到她不可避免的垮台。你会帮助她绽放吗？或者你会让她枯萎吗？

[来自[url=https://vnnuuuuu.itch.io/the-root-of-evil]Itch.io[/url]]
